seo.title: Experiences & Sightseeing | The Udaisarovar, Udaipur
seo.description: Infinity pool on the lake, lakeside camping, bonfire nights, open-air cinema, horse riding and Udaipur, Nathdwara and Chittorgarh day trips from The Udaisarovar.

hero.label: Experiences
hero.title: Days by the pool, nights under the stars

experiences.title: Infinity pool on the lake
experiences.text: The edge of the pool meets Udai Sagar, the signature view of every stay. Two swim sessions daily, 8–11 AM and 4:30–7:30 PM.

experiences.title: Lakeside camping
experiences.text: Tents on the lake shore with a bonfire and live music system. Mattress, bed and blanket, breakfast and campsite assistance are included. Best from October to March; group camps on request.

experiences.title: Bonfire & music nights
experiences.text: Gather round the fire on the lawn with music, with the lights of the lake shimmering across the water.

experiences.title: Cinema under the stars
experiences.text: An open-air projector screening by the lake, every night from 9 PM.

experiences.title: Horse riding
experiences.text: Ride our white horse across the lakeside lawns with our riding partner. Add it to any retreat package for ₹999 per person, or ask at reception.

list.title: Horse riding
list.text: Our white horse on the lakeside lawns.

list.title: The view
list.text: Udai Sagar and the Aravalli hills from the resort.

list.title: Welcome
list.text: A walk through the cottages, pool and lawns.

sightseeing.label: Sightseeing by cab
sightseeing.title: Explore Udaipur and Mewar
sightseeing.text: We arrange the cab. Book at reception, in the Guest App or on WhatsApp.

trips.title: Udaipur city tour
trips.text: City Palace, Lake Pichola, Jagdish Temple, Saheliyon ki Bari, Fateh Sagar, Sajjangarh Monsoon Palace and Bagore ki Haveli.

trips.title: Nathdwara
trips.text: Shrinathji darshan, with a full-day cab.

trips.title: Chittorgarh
trips.text: Fort and city day trip. Sedan for up to 4 guests; Ertiga for 5 on request.
